categories.name: Stainless Steel JIC Adapters
categories.shortDescription: 316L stainless steel 37° JIC adapters: unions, connectors to NPT, elbows, tees, crosses, bulkhead fittings, swivel adapters, caps, plugs, nuts and sleeves, each with a full size table.
categories.seoDescription: 316L stainless 37° JIC adapters: unions, NPT connectors, 90° and 45° elbows, tees, crosses and bulkhead fittings, with size tables and Parker equivalents.

hero.intro: 37° JIC adapters in 316L stainless steel, for hydraulic and process lines where zinc-plated carbon steel would corrode.

guidance.heading: Choosing a stainless JIC adapter
guidance.body: Confirm the end is a 37° flare, not a 45° SAE flare: the two share threads in some sizes but do not seal on each other. Read the thread on each end, then pick the body form. Each listing gives every size with its part number and, where published, its dimensions and Parker equivalent.

standards.heading: SAE J514 and ISO 8434-2
standards.body: The 37° flare connection is defined by SAE J514 and ISO 8434-2. It seals metal to metal on the flare, so no sealant goes on the thread. Pipe-thread ends follow ASME B1.20.1.

items.a: Most families are 316L stainless steel, forged; each listing states the grade the manufacturer gives. Where a listing says stainless steel without a grade, ask and we will confirm before you order.

items.q: Do the listings show dimensions and equivalents?
items.a: Yes, where the manufacturer publishes them. Every size is listed with its end sizes; most also carry millimetre dimensions and the Parker part number the manufacturer cross-references.

items.q: Will a stainless JIC adapter mate with a carbon-steel one?
items.a: Yes, the 37° flare is the same; mixing materials in a wet line can cause galvanic corrosion, so most specifications keep a stainless line stainless.

hero.intro: SAE O-ring boss adapters in 316L stainless steel, for straight-thread ports on pumps, valves and manifolds.

guidance.heading: Fixed or adjustable
guidance.body: An ORB port seals on an O-ring under the hex, so a straight male stud is simply screwed in. Elbows and tees come as adjustable fittings with a locknut, so the branch can be set to any angle before the O-ring is clamped.

standards.heading: SAE J1926 and ISO 11926
standards.body: The O-ring boss port is defined by SAE J1926 (ISO 11926). The 37° flare ends on JIC × ORB adapters follow SAE J514.

categories.seoTitle: Stainless Steel ORFS Adapters, O-Ring Face Seal
categories.seoDescription: Stainless O-ring face seal (ORFS) adapters: unions, elbows, tees, bulkhead fittings and ORFS × NPT adapters, with size tables and dimensions.

hero.intro: O-ring face seal adapters in stainless steel, for high-pressure, high-vibration lines that must not weep.

guidance.heading: Why face seal
guidance.body: An ORFS joint seals on an O-ring held in a groove on the male face, pressed flat against the female face. It tolerates vibration and resists over-tightening better than a metal-to-metal seat, which is why mobile and offshore hydraulics specify it.

standards.heading: SAE J1453 and ISO 8434-3
standards.body: The O-ring face seal connection is defined by SAE J1453 and ISO 8434-3. Replace the O-ring each time the joint is broken.

categories.seoDescription: 316L stainless NPT pipe adapters and NPSM swivels: couplings, hex nipples, bushings, plugs, caps, elbows, tees and crosses, with size tables and pressure ratings.

hero.intro: NPT taper-thread and NPSM swivel adapters in 316L stainless steel, for hydraulic, chemical and food-grade lines.

guidance.heading: NPT or NPSM
guidance.body: NPT is a taper thread that seals on the thread flanks with sealant or tape. NPSM is a straight thread on a swivel nut that seals on a 30° seat, so it can be made up without twisting the line. Do not seal an NPSM joint on its thread.

standards.heading: ASME B1.20.1 and B31.3
standards.body: NPT and NPSM threads are defined by ASME B1.20.1. The pipe-fitting listings carry the manufacturer's pressure ratings to ASME B31.3, by size, for male and female ends.

guidance.heading: BSPP or BSPT
guidance.body: BSPP (parallel) ports seal on a bonded seal, O-ring or cone seat, not on the thread; BSPT (taper) threads seal on the flanks like NPT. The two have the same pitch but do not interchange. Use a bonded seal with a BSPP male stud.

standards.heading: ISO 228-1 and ISO 7-1
standards.body: BSPP threads are defined by ISO 228-1 and BSPT by ISO 7-1. Metric dual-purpose ends take a DIN 2353 tube nut or fit a metric port.

guidance.heading: Light, heavy or extra light
guidance.body: DIN 2353 fittings come in series that share a tube size but not a thread: the light (L) series suits general hydraulics and the heavy (S) series higher pressure, with a larger thread for the same tube. standards.body: The 24° cone bite-type connection is defined by DIN 2353, now ISO 8434-1. The cutting ring bites into the tube as the nut is made up, which is why the manufacturer notes its resistance to vibration.

products.descriptionLong:
The Stainless Steel BSPP Male Nipple is a nipple in stainless steel. It carries two BSPP male ends. Stainless steel is chosen where corrosion rules out zinc-plated carbon steel: offshore and marine lines, chemical, fertiliser and petroleum plant, and food, beverage and pharmaceutical process equipment.

Construction

  • Body: nipple
  • End 1: BSPP male
  • End 2: BSPP male
  • Material: stainless steel

Ends and sealing

  • BSPP: BSP parallel thread, sealed by a bonded seal, O-ring or cone seat; ISO 228-1.

Sizes

10 part numbers, 1/8" to 2". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: 1/8" BSPP (G1/8-28) to 2" BSPP (G2-11)
  • End 2: 1/8" BSPP (G1/8-28) to 2" BSPP (G2-11)

Pressure rating

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. Tell us the working pressure your line sees and we will confirm the fitting is rated for it before you order.

Carbon-steel version

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you only have the fitting, send the thread or tube size on each end and the material, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

The Stainless Steel JIC 37° Male × JIC Female Swivel Connector is a straight connector in 316L stainless steel, forged from one piece. It carries a 37° JIC male end and a 37° JIC female end. products.title: Stainless Steel JIC 37° Swivel Nut Run Tee
products.descriptionShort: Stainless Steel JIC 37° Swivel Nut Run Tee in 316L stainless steel, forged. 10 part numbers, 1/4" to 2"; the size table gives the size on each end, dimensions in millimetres and the Parker equivalent for every Indus part number.
products.descriptionLong:
The Stainless Steel JIC 37° Swivel Nut Run Tee is a run tee in 316L stainless steel, forged from one piece. It carries a 37° JIC male end and a 37° JIC female end and a 37° JIC male end. Stainless steel is chosen where corrosion rules out zinc-plated carbon steel: offshore and marine lines, chemical, fertiliser and petroleum plant, and food, beverage and pharmaceutical process equipment.

Construction

  • Body: run tee
  • End 1: 37° JIC male
  • End 2: 37° JIC female swivel
  • End 3: 37° JIC male
  • Material: 316L stainless steel, forged

Ends and sealing

  • 37° JIC: 37° flare, a metal-to-metal seat on a 74° included cone; SAE J514 / ISO 8434-2.

Sizes

10 part numbers, 1/4" to 2". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end, dimensions in millimetres and the Parker equivalent for every one.

  • End 1: 1/4" JIC 37° (7/16-20) to 2" JIC 37° (2-1/2-12)
  • End 2: 1/4" JIC 37° (7/16-20) to 2" JIC 37° (2-1/2-12)
  • End 3: 1/4" JIC 37° (7/16-20) to 2" JIC 37° (2-1/2-12)

products.descriptionLong:
The Stainless Steel Bonded Seal, BSPP is a bonded seal in stainless steel. It carries a BSPP male end. Stainless steel is chosen where corrosion rules out zinc-plated carbon steel: offshore and marine lines, chemical, fertiliser and petroleum plant, and food, beverage and pharmaceutical process equipment.

Construction

  • End 1: BSPP male
  • Material: stainless steel

Ends and sealing

Sizes

10 part numbers, 1/8" to 2". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size for every one.

  • End 1: 1/8" BSPP (G1/8-28) to 2" BSPP (G2-11)

Pressure rating

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. Tell us the working pressure your line sees and we will confirm the fitting is rated for it before you order.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you only have the fitting, send the thread or tube size on each end and the material, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
